title: Reditus & Structura Reditus: Field Constitution & Core-Object Formalization for Admissible Return Through Collapse
version: June 2026 (title-page date; no version label stated)

tier_1: Field constitution: Reditus defined as the core object (admissible return of structure through collapse under declared conditions) and Structura Reditus as the field that studies it; Axiom-0 as governing axiom; admissible return distinguished from repetition, persistence, resemblance, repair, recovery by assertion, and rhetorical continuity.
Order of the mature hierarchy: object before field, field before theory, theory before protocol, protocol before domain application.

scope: States what the object is, what the field is, how the mature hierarchy is ordered, and what burden must be satisfied before a structure may receive return credit.
non_goal: Does not replace the technical collapse-kernel reference, the operational whitepaper, the worked passes, the closure papers, or the teaching route; does not re-prove every kernel identity, reproduce every domain closure, or restate the complete publication architecture.
